rationale: Article-level ZPlaSSIED republication is a sub-page of the racunovodstvo.net legislation hub; unofficial and unclear legal status.
Archive section of bsi.si, already covered by monitoring the Banka Slovenije publications parent.
PxWeb statistical warehouse is a standalone machine-queryable central-bank data layer; failed check is soft only.
EU-maintained map of Slovenian legal databases — mine once for the authoritative registers, then archive.
Commission representation newsroom surfaces Slovenian transposition and infringement signals in local language.
Privately maintained NIS2 transposition tracker; banking-adjacent and unverified reachability, re-check later.
PISRS is the authoritative legislation register and official gazette platform — the primary dated channel for A3 Slovenia.
Gazette publisher's alerting/newsletter layer is a cheap tripwire for new banking, AML and payments acts.
Parliament's consolidated-text register signals closed amendment cycles for ZBan and ZPlaSSIED.
Ministry of Finance RSS is a ready-made structured feed for consultations and bill adoption on the core statutes.
National Council veto and opinions are the main schedule-risk signal a gazette-only feed misses.
Supervisor legal-basis page for payment services sits under bsi.si; covered by the parent Banka Slovenije monitoring.
Practitioner aggregator with useful amendment timelines but low credibility and unclear reuse terms.
Unofficial statute browser; navigation aid only, redundant against PISRS.
LEXPERA legal news wire is fast and actor-rich but largely subscription-gated; a human must clear access.
N-Lex country description is a stable one-time pointer to the authoritative Slovenian database.
National CKAN open-data portal is a durable discovery surface for machine-readable legislative feeds.
PISRS legislation-metadata dataset gives structured regulation records including lapsed and abandoned drafts.
English gazette route is thin and non-authoritative; records an expectation rather than a productive source.
EBA consultation register carries hard deadlines that precede Slovenian applicability; failed check is soft only.
Single Rulebook hub indexes Level 1 acts to RTS/ITS with application dates — mine to enumerate binding instruments.
Guideline compliance tables state Banka Slovenije's comply/intend-to-comply status — direct Slovenian applicability evidence.
EBA opinions and reports feed sets supervisory end-dates that NCAs including Banka Slovenije apply.
EUCLID public registers map SI credit, payment and e-money institutions plus passporting — structural scope map.
ECB supervised-entity list defines the SI significant-versus-LSI perimeter; monthly refresh.
SSM supervisory priorities are a leading indicator of examination pressure flowing to SI banks.
ECB public consultations carry hard deadlines and become directly applicable without national transposition.
